rules.title: Ban on algorithmic or software-based coordination of rents
rules.requirement: Hoboken landlords may not use software, algorithms or data-sharing platforms to coordinate or recommend rents, lease terms or occupancy. If you think your landlord set your rent this way, you can raise it with the city.
rules.coverage_conditions: All residential rental units in Hoboken. The sources state no limits based on building size or age.
rules.reason: Both candidates are secondary sources describing the same Hoboken ordinance (ch. 158-2) with the same text and date, so they were merged.
